name: Claymorphism
blurb: Soft modelling-clay UI: candy pastels on warm cream, 24-32px corners and full pills, and a zero-blur offset drop paired with an inset white highlight that makes every surface look extruded and squishy. Hover swells, press squashes.

tagline.en: Candy pastels, fat corners, squishy 3D depth
tagline.zh: 糖果马卡龙，超大圆角，捏得动的立体感

origin.note: Vetta-adapted from the StyleKit「粘土拟态」guide and its showcase page: rewritten as Vetta spec prose and re-expressed in Vetta base tokens. Shadow and palette values follow the showcase's own CSS. No upstream assets included.
